## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** The keeper uses qty=10. Assuming an entry premium of ~$1.00, the risk per trade is $1000 (10 contracts * $1.00 * 100). This requires an account size of at least $2000 to risk 50% per trade ($1000 is 50% of $2000). For a $1K paper account, the realized P&L would be scaled by 50% (since max qty would be 5).
